description: This Kotlin source file defines the PlayerViewModel class, which manages video player state, subtitles, translation, and user preferences for an Android app. It handles subtitle cues, language preferences, auto-translation toggles, and stream URL resolution.

classes.name: PlayerViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing the state of the media player, subtitles, translation preferences, and error handling within the Android app.

methods.name: onPlayerError
methods.description: Handles playback errors by updating the UI state with an error message.

methods.name: onCues
methods.description: Processes incoming subtitle cues, merges them, and updates the subtitle display with optional translation.

methods.name: setCcEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables closed caption display.

methods.name: setShowBothSubtitles
methods.description: Toggles display of both original and translated subtitles.

methods.name: resolveStreamUrl
methods.description: Resolves and returns the stream URL, defaulting if no custom URL is set.

methods.name: resolveSidecarVtt
methods.description: Resolves and returns the URI for sidecar VTT subtitles if available.
